notes.title: Feedback and improvements
notes.content:
Hello gamers!
Quriocity was released more than a year ago, and we are delighted to see so many players actively playing it and enjoying it.

We have received a lot of feedback from you and we worked to implement such improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Improved UI
[*] Minor fixes for translations
[*] Better performance
[*] Faster loading times
[/list]
Thank you to all of you who are playing Quriocity and encouraging us to make our game even better.
We will be delighted to see your new colonies, so feel free to share your progress!
The Oxeliz team

notes.title: Major Update: Full controller support
notes.content:
Hello gamers!
We are very happy to announce the [b]first Major Update [/b]of Quriocity!

In this major update we introduce [b]full controller support[/b], which includes [b]4 controller profiles [/b]with different input mappings. You will be able to find them in the Settings panel, so if you like to play with the controller, please take a look and find the layout that best suits you.
[b]All modern standard controllers are supported[/b]: Xbox controllers, PlayStation controllers, Switch controllers, and third-party controllers.
The controller inputs are also fully integrated in the tutorials and in the game UI, which will adapt on the fly to the input system you are using.

We have added a [b]new functionality[/b]: the [b]units snapping[/b]. By enabling this feature, you will be able to easily snap the units to each other as you place them on the map. This feature supports both controller and mouse.

We have [b]improved the memory optimization [/b]to save up to 50% of the space without reducing the visual quality. We have [b]improved the overall performances [/b]of the game, and we have fixed some minor bugs.

As always, feel free to share your thoughts. You can do that on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2060240][b]Steam[/b][/url] and on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/dnK8wFe][b]Discord server[/b][/url].

Happy colony building!
The Oxeliz team

We have added a new functionality: the units snapping.

tags.bug: and we have fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Patchnotes for 17th August
notes.content:
[list]

[*] The auto service research are now faster and cheaper (the values are more similar to the other research)
[*] Increased the size of the buttons in the Actions center
[*] Added arrows to represent over- and underproduction in top UI and for Sewage and Garbage
[*] Improved the red blink effect in the left UI to make it more visible
[*] Reduced memory usage by up to 20%
[*] Minor fixes for localization
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Full Release announcement!
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

We are very excited to announce that the Full Release of Quriocity will be available on [b]July the 25th[/b]!

Let’s have a quick overview of the new features that you will experience in the full game.

[h2]5 new maps[/h2]
The full game will include 5 new maps, each set in a [b]beautiful and unique environment[/b].

Take a first look at these gorgeous biomes and the peculiar plants that characterize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/4878083f4efe11da7f65bb9fa042dc8dce1e1e42.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/917018213c267d94737bcc572419802f5040ee99.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/a1b53c906a0b40a906e024621f76acc6d9048063.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/0843b819e54c00fca9cb41dda7d71dcb062ae233.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/1af1eac120b01f721d4daee2e26061a8f9b878a4.png[/img]

[h2]Dynamic weather[/h2]
The maps not only look different; each features a [b]specific weather[/b], ranging from the freezing Tundra to the scorching Desert. Moreover, the [b]weather will change dynamically according to the seasons[/b], with hot and cold temperature, rain, snow, and heatwaves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/da9d4e2e3c39dbc20c24019a3d1cbe5ce18743e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/79fcb2e9c1d2b6142a6628d163042758b44bf664.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/bec45277ba5631152319d7963c01ca31e768aa07.png[/img]

But there is more! In each season-map combination [b]dangerous natural disasters[/b] might occur, including Sandstorms, Tornadoes, Blizzards, and Earthquakes. They might look threatening (well, they are!), but don’t worry; you have all the tools required to protect your colony, so get ready to use them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/e74686be9be0cd38a1937b1a2cccbc550979bcca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/04b01e95301a86220fba8135bf272add89e875c2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/d7117a47f66ec00523e190d4e1e3e6bc1ca5152b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/d952706be70e0f5c924a25458fb9af223d22572d.png[/img]

[h2]Campaigns[/h2]
Take new challenges and try your hand at [b]48 unique campaigns [/b]that will test your management skills in various situations. Explore different aspects of the game, adapt your strategy to achieve multiple goals, and do your best to fix some very unbalanced colonies.

But don’t worry, as you will be able to learn everything about the game in [b]3 tutorial campaigns[/b]. Whether you are a Quriocity veteran, a new player, or someone who has never tried a colony management game, you will find all the information you need to succeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/5baee2d9b6f0a39db807574bb188be6cb9c9c2bb.png[/img]

[h2]Difficulty levels and Sandbox mode[/h2]
When choosing the [b]Survival mode[/b], you can now pick a difficulty level: a relaxing easy experience, an intermediate challenge, or a hard management undertaking.

Additionally, we have added a [b]Sandbox mode [/b]where you can tweak each parameter individually and set some additional options to play at your own rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/48fe226a12d84bd824b5c46ac44c712915c2ff82.png[/img]

[h2]And more![/h2]
In addition to the above, we have added new units, new rovers, new research, and new quality-of-life improvements.

We have listened to all the feedback we have received, and in the last months, we have worked hard to make Quriocity even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/847aecbaf80bf85d6c61109c10380ecfbd549980.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43019434/f604e83ab0c1debde6771ae94c31a52437e9ada1.png[/img]

Again, the Full Release of Quriocity will become available on [b]July the 25th[/b], so stay tuned!

Thank you so much for your patience and your interest in our game!
The Oxeliz team

notes.title: Full release coming soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce that the development of the full release of Quriocity is advancing, and we expect to publish it [b]this year in Q1[/b].

Here are some of the new exciting features that we will include:
[list]
[*] 5 new maps in unique environments to let you experience Quriocity in different situations and build more diversified colonies
[*] Seasons, dynamic weather conditions, dynamic temperature, and natural disasters such as Earthquakes, Tornadoes, Blizzards, and Heat waves will impact the balance of your colony
[*] New units, new rovers, and new research to help you face the challenges of the new environments
[*] 20+ campaigns that will test your skills in challenging situations
[*] Sandbox mode with custom rules to create your favorite colony
[*] Three difficulty tiers (easy, medium, and hard)
[/list]
As always, you can reach us here or on our official [url=https://discord.gg/dnK8wFe][b]Discord server[/b][/url] if you want to share feedback or if you have suggestions.

Thank you all for the support, and stay tuned for more updates!
The Oxeliz team

notes.title: Patchnotes for 15th December
notes.content:
[list]
[*] An improved UI for the World view showing the Communication tower location and the available services in the region.
[*] A new UI for the Principle rover with more information and more details about the rovers that it contains.
[*] An improved Game guide with tool-tips for the units.
[*] A new Units status panel that will help you in choosing which buildings to upgrade.
[*] A new main menu UI.
[*] The Search rover and the Recharge rover are now manual.
[*] The sectors will be highlighted while you are adding a unit to make it easier to understand where you can and where you cannot place the unit.
[*] Updated tutorials to reflect the new features.
[*] Added an Ok button on some tutorials so you don’t need to perform the suggested action immediately.
[*] Fixed Chinese localization.
[*] Improved readability for Chinese, Japanese and Russian.
[*] Pausing the game doesn’t deselect the current unit anymore.
[*] Fixed the toggle in the Employment and Spaceport panel.
[*] The Pest type label in the farms info panel blinks during an attack to underline the type of pest.
[*] Added lights to service rovers.
[*] Various other minor improvements and bug-fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: First minor update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thank you a lot for your feedback. We really appreciated the time you dedicated to our game, and we would like to let you know about a minor update that we will release on [b]November the 10th[/b].

The update will feature the following improvements:
[list]
[*] Edge scrolling to move the camera when the mouse is near the edge of the screen. 
[*] Faster and easier services management, as now you will be able to click straight on the Actions center entry or on the icon above the unit to send the service rovers.
[*] Add units also when the game is paused.
[*] Rotate the clusters even if there are already units inside them.
[*] The units that do not depend on a specific resource can now be placed in all sectors.
[*] The Health clinic is available in level 1.
[*] Increased the max zoom out and decreased the max zoom in.
[*] Added option for tooltips delay.
[*] Updated tutorials to reflect the new features.
[/list]
Apart from that, we will continue working on the features for the Full Release and on other minor refinements, so stay tuned for more updates and let us know if you have any suggestions.

Thank you all for the support!
The Oxeliz team
